protocol.scope: one main-ratio joint conditional/unconditional CFG model plus triangle development check

selection.rule: Select at each step budget from g>1 candidates that preserve coverage and validity, then lexicographically minimize failed FEM cases, mean successful spectral MARE, nearest-twin/separation, guidance scale. Compare the selected guided200 candidate with g1/200 under the same rule; retain g1 as recommended if no acceptable improvement.
selection.fallback: If no g>1 is admissible, record none admissible and report the least-bad candidate as diagnostic only; do not recommend it.
selection.fallback_rule: Minimize number of violated constraints, then sum of normalized violations, then the standard FEM/geometry/g ranking; diagnostic only.

notes: Guidance scales chosen on validation only.
g0 andg1 execute one denoiser call per step; other scales execute two.
FEM failures retained; ranking explicitly distinguishes failures from success-only error.

explicit_null_equivalence.status: Compared saved g0 and explicit-null g1 samples with matching random seed/settings

notes: Guidance scales selected on validation only; test results do not revise selection
Historical conditional-only model and new joint model differ in condition dropout and context architecture
Historical dataset hash matches; its saved baseline draws receive a fresh FEM check on the same fixed rows/seed as current models
Matched NFE comparison: guided100 uses 200 predictor evaluations; ordinary conditional200 uses 200
FEM means/medians are success-only; failure counts and below-1% fractions retain all requested cases
Both-mode coverage and sharpness apply only to separated pairs; truth error uses all saved draws
